items.title: Govt allocates Rs. 34 Million for former presidents in 2027 Budget: Minister
items.summary: The government has allocated Rs. 34 million for former Presidents under the President’s expenditure head in the 2027 Budget, Minister Ananda Wijepala said in Parliament today.

items.title: Human-elephant conflict action plan to be submitted by December 20
items.summary: A preliminary draft of the National Action Plan to manage the human-elephant conflict (HEC) is expected to be submitted to the Parliamentary Oversight Committee by December 20, 2026.

items.title: West Asia crisis hinders expressway construction in Sri Lanka
items.summary: The West Asian crisis has hampered road construction, including the development of proposed expressways, due to difficulties in importing bitumen, a petroleum by-product, an official said.

items.title: Supreme Court rules Prevention of Organised Crime Bill consistent with Constitution
items.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that the Prevention of Organised Crime Bill is not inconsistent with the Constitution and can therefore be passed in Parliament with a simple majority, subject to certain amendments.

items.title: The FBI was hacked again, this time the breach targeted its crime database
items.summary: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its nationwide criminal information database that serves as a lifeline between federal, state and local law enforcement, two people briefed on the investigation said.

items.title: NASA astronaut shares stunning view of Sri Lanka from space
